# trustmebro-meter — Results Dashboard

Open `index.html` directly in any browser, or enable GitHub Pages on `/docs`.

**GitHub Pages setup:** Settings → Pages → Deploy from branch → `main` → `/docs`.

**Data:** `results.js` is regenerated by `bench/assemble.ts` and committed alongside the dashboard. It exposes a single `window.TRUSTMEBRO_RESULTS` global consumed by `app.js`.

No build step. No bundler. No network dependencies. It just works.
